Sub FixOrder
Dim oComps, oComp, oDoc, oSheets, i%
Dim n(9) As String
n(0)="ReadMe"
n(1)="Raw_data"
n(2)="Beans"
n(3)="Millet"
n(4)="Sorghum"
n(5)="Mkt Gotheye"
n(6)="Mkt Mangaize"
n(7)="Mkt Ouallam"
n(8)="Mkt Tera"
n(9)="Millet spatial integration"
oComps = StarDesktop.Components.createEnumeration()
Do While oComps.hasMoreElements()
oComp = oComps.nextElement()
If InStr(oComp.getURL(), ".xlsx") > 0 Then
oDoc = oComp
End If
Loop
oSheets = oDoc.Sheets
For i = 0 To 9
oSheets.moveByName(n(i), i)
Next i
oDoc.store()
End Sub
memo: Typed FixOrder macro into Module1 (reorders sheets of the .xlsx doc to ReadMe..Millet spatial integration, then store). Next: press F5 to run, then verify tab order in Calc.
